input.prompt: Wide architectural photograph of a vast dark exposed-concrete hall with board-formed concrete walls and a polished dark concrete floor. Filling most of the far wall is one enormous seamless rectangular LED screen, perfectly flat and front-facing, slightly above eye level, displaying one plain uniform soft white-grey glow and nothing else. The screen is the only light source; its cool-neutral light falls across the floor, producing a long soft reflection on the polished concrete, and fades into deep shadow at the edges of the hall. Camera at eye level, centred, 28mm lens, deep calm symmetry. Shot on a Sony A7R V, true-to-life colour, realistic exposure, fine natural grain, restrained cinematic grade with soft highlights and warm shadows. Quiet luxury, architectural photography. No people. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
